author: Myworld6
body:
Hello seniors/admins. This is more of a suggestion than a question, but given the current problem with staff activity, I propose the use of hourly shifts. How this would work is a spreadsheet is posted every week with times on it, e.g. 9:00 am - 10:00 am. A mod would then put their IGN on this spreadsheet for different times to moderate. 

Of course, this would only work if the mods had a minimum weekly requirement that they had to achieve. Thus, I also propose a minimum of 3-4 hours per week for those who aren't on a LOA or who haven't announced that they won't be active for one reason or another.

Now, what would the benefits of this be? Not only would it ensure mod accountability for not dealing with reports when they come in while they are online, but it would also indicate which mods are inactive and therefore something can be done about this.

I'll leave this up to you. Thank you and have a nice day.

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body: Someone suggested this not that long ago, we looked into the idea but I don't think we would do something exactly like that. We may adopt a version of this but at this point we're looking to change the LOA system.
